newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg up on bid rumor, market strength.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg up on bid rumor, market strength.

text.p: Shares of cereal marker Kellogg Co rose 7/8 to 84, bolstered by strength in the overall stock market and rumors that Unilever Plc might consider a bid for it.

Analysts, however, discounted the market rumor that Unilever would seek to buy Kellogg, noting that about one-third of Kellogg's stock is held by the Kellogg Foundation, which could prevent a hostile bid.
"It seems extremely unlikely," Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette analyst William Leach said of the rumor.
"I have heard a rumor by the day regarding Unilever," added Goldman Sachs anlayst Nomi Ghez, discounting the rumor Unilever might buy Kellogg.
"I think the rumor mill here is fruitless," she said.
Ghez added that Kellogg also is benefiting from the overall strength of the stock market, along with other large-capitalization food companies.
